messages:
Maya (CSM): Hey team — kicking off Lyranet onboarding (healthcare pilot). Need to align stakeholders, success criteria, and a 30/60/90 timeline. Thinking kickoff Friday 9am PT. Quick wins we want: SSO, API integration, and a working demo.
Raul (Product): I can represent product. High-level success: SSO + API + embed latency <250ms for typical payloads. Renewal risk: compliance + slow integration.
Sam (Eng): Sam here. I can own API keys + sample app + sandbox setup. Need model choice and expected QPS to size. ETA: sandbox in ~2w, prod in ~4w if nothing blocks.
Ellie (Enablement): I'll own docs + enablement training. Plan a 30m workshop after prod baseline is stable. Need feature list for slides.
Jon (Support): I'll spin up KB and support rotation. Agree weekly health check cadence. Also will draft an onboarding FAQ.
Maya (CSM): Thanks — I'm capturing notes. Proposed 30/60/90 (very high level) below. Please flag issues.
```
30d: SSO configured, sandbox integration, sample app demo to stakeholders
60d: Production API keys, basic monitoring + alerting, enablement workshop delivered
90d: Success metrics dashboard, customer feedback collection, playbook for scaling
```
Sam (Eng): :thumbsup: One thing — Lyranet requires EU data residency and KMS for keys. Might push us toward Private/Dedicated options.
Raul (Product): Good catch. Add 'Data residency / KMS' to risk register. That could affect timelines and cost; let's surface to sales.
Maya (CSM): Noted and added. Also plan to capture qualitative feedback via a short weekly survey and a 10-example eval set for quality regressions.
Ellie (Enablement): I can build the survey and a short checklist for their PMs to run. Proposed 3 quick Qs: usefulness, clarity of docs, blockers.
Jon (Support): I'll add an escalation path: P1 -> Eng oncall within 1 hour, plus shared Slack channel with their ops.
Maya (CSM): Tentative owner list (please confirm): SSO = Sam, API + sandbox = Sam, Docs + training = Ellie, KB + support ops = Jon, Compliance/data residency = Raul. If no objections, I'll lock by EOD.
Sam (Eng): No objections. @Maya I'll need staging creds and any network allowlists — please request from Lyranet.
Maya (CSM): Will request staging creds now. @Ellie can you draft the slide deck by Wed so Raul/sales can review?
Ellie (Enablement): On it. I'll include a short runbook and the survey link.
onboard-bot: Meeting scheduled: Fri 2026-03-27 09:00 PT — calendar invite sent to attendees.
Maya (CSM): Also adding a renewal-facing metric: goal is DAU of the integration and cost per 1k tokens < $0.35 to stay within their procurement thresholds. We'll track that on the 60d dashboard.
Raul (Product): I'll coordinate with sales on contract language for data residency and traction milestones.
Maya (CSM): Great — action items captured. I'll follow up with a short doc and invites. Thanks everyone.
